# tacsim's integration test targets and the CI cells that run them
# (.github/workflows/ci.yml's `tacsim-integration-N`; scripts/ci-tacsim-shard.sh N).
#
# Since doc 43 cut TS.12's adoption (D-43-5, 2026-11-04) tacsim's tests are
# four DOMAIN binaries, `crates/tacsim/tests/<domain>.rs` with their modules
# under `tests/<domain>/`, and every cell builds all four and runs its hash
# share of their tests: `cargo nextest run --partition hash:N/10`. Balance is
# the hash's, so nothing is ever resharded; a new test is a `mod` line in its
# domain root, never a line here. Measured (doc 43 cut notes, TS.12): about
# +26 to +31 s of compile and link a cell against the ten hand-balanced
# shard binaries, the wall and balance no worse.
#
# The `partition:` line names the partitioned binaries. A numbered line
# `N: target ...` names the targets cell N runs FIRST, by name and whole,
# before its share of the partition (an empty line runs none):
# - harness stays a target of its own (its `#![recursion_limit]` is
#   crate-root-only) and is cell 1's.
# - cost_lane runs alone (.config/nextest.toml: threads-required = the whole
#   pool) and is cell 2's, so its serial minutes sit on one cell, first,
#   rather than stalling all ten (TS.12: with opt-level 1 it no longer makes
#   cell 2 the wall).
# Every top-level `tests/*.rs` target appears exactly once in this file
# (`ci_tacsim_shards` is the guard), and the workflow's matrix runs exactly
# the numbered cells.
partition: domain_arena domain_economy domain_field domain_world
1: harness
2: cost_lane
3:
4:
5:
